Wait, but previously after clicking 13 blocks, the level didn't complete. Maybe I need to click all 14 blocks for the level to complete.

3. Click the remaining block (cols 49-53)
4. Level should complete
But wait, after moving the agent, the new block above the agent (cols 43-47) becomes the "trap". So I can't click it. But I already clicked it in step 1.
So the sequence is:
1. Agent at cols 50-51 (under block 7)

sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Agent at cols 50-51, under block at cols 49-53
# Click all blocks except bottom row block at cols 49-53

# Top row: all 7 blocks
top_blocks = [(27, 15), (27, 21), (27, 27), (27, 33), (27, 39), (27, 45), (27, 51)]
# Bottom row: all except last (cols 49-53)
bottom_blocks = [(33, 15), (33, 21), (33, 27), (33, 33), (33, 39), (33, 45)]

all_clicks = top_blocks + bottom_blocks
print(f"Clicking {len(all_clicks)} blocks")

for row, col in all_clicks:
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': row, 'col': col}])
    if last_action_result.get('game_over'):
        print(f"Game over after ({row}, {col})")
        break
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print(f"Level completed after ({row}, {col})")
        break

# Check state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
n_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks remaining: {len(n_nodes)}")

if not last_action_result.get('game_over') and not last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
    # Move agent LEFT to cols 45-46
    action(['LEFT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    agent_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b']
    for n in agent_nodes:
        b = n['boundary']
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"Agent cols after LEFT: {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")
    
    # Click last bottom row block
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 33, 'col': 51}])
    print(f"After clicking last block: game_over={last_action_result.get('game_over')}, level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
    
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    n_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
    print(f"Green blocks remaining: {len(n_nodes)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
